integrity: Proof is analytical. Supplementary finite numerical assertions do not substitute for universal proof; independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite matrix multiplicity and degree-one harmonic symbols; graph closure of polynomial-core realization only. Commutator is a bounded form extension, not a globally defined unbounded product. No statement on higher degrees, infinite coefficient dimensions, other maximal realizations or subnormality. Literature priority not exhaustive.
title: Hyponormality rigidity for affine matrix-valued Fock–Sobolev Toeplitz operators
